description: Returns a sports team's current roster for Plot Speaks Team Trivia, read live from ESPN (cached for hours): players grouped by position with jersey numbers, and the head coach, as plain text. Covers the leagues in the Team Trivia database. Reads only; nothing is recorded. A name that fits several teams returns an error listing the candidates with their leagues; a team not in the database returns an error listing the leagues covered; if ESPN does not answer, the text says so.

team.description: The team as the player said it: a city, name, nickname or abbreviation, e.g. Steelers, Pittsburgh or PIT; a full name such as Pittsburgh Steelers is the most exact

name: team_roster
title: Team roster
